about.heroTitle: A research laboratory for dependable systems.
about.heroDescription: RAMS Laboratory works at the intersection of marine engineering, industrial reliability, safety, maintenance, and maritime systems.
about.profileTitle: Where engineering questions become structured evidence.
about.profileP1: RAMS—Reliability, Availability, Management & Safety—supports research and industrial consulting for systems where performance, risk, and lifecycle decisions are closely connected.
about.profileP2: Its marine and offshore perspective is complemented by methods that travel across industries: risk assessment, reliability modeling, maintenance strategy, simulation, and data-informed decision support.

callout.baseValue: Gedung WA, Kampus ITS Sukolilo, Surabaya

about.visionTitle: Useful research for safer, more available systems.
about.visionDescription: The laboratory’s direction is expressed through applied research, multidisciplinary collaboration, and engineering work that helps organizations understand and improve complex assets.
about.visionText: To advance dependable marine and industrial systems through rigorous research and practical collaboration.
about.missionText: To develop methods, models, and engineering insight for reliability, safety, Management, and system performance.
about.timelineDescription: A concise view of the laboratory’s source-supported history and direction.
about.ecosystemDescription: The public identity brings together RAMS Laboratory’s reliability and safety work with the blue maritime systems direction of AIS-ITS.
about.ctaTitle: Build the next dependable system with us.

research.heroTitle: Research that turns complex systems into better decisions.
research.heroDescription: RAMS research connects technical models with the operational questions faced by marine, offshore, and industrial organizations.

research.processTitle: From engineering questions to better decisions.
research.processDescription: Every research area follows the same engineering logic: understand the system, analyse the evidence, model the behavior, and support the decision.

understand.title: Understand
understand.text: Hazard identification, failure behavior, and the operational context of the system.

analyse.title: Analyse
analyse.text: Data preparation, spatial analysis, criticality, and consequence mapping.

model.title: Model
model.text: FMEA, FTA, reliability blocks, and simulation models of system behavior.

decide.title: Decide
decide.text: Decision support, maintenance planning, and scenario-informed operations.

research.applicationText: Marine and offshore systems, industrial facilities, maritime traffic, operational safety, asset performance, and engineering decision support.
research.featuredDescription: Selected research and engineering projects from RAMS Laboratory.
research.industryDescription: RAMS methods connect directly to operational practice: reliability, safety, maintenance, and risk inform how marine and industrial systems are designed, operated, and maintained.

industryPoints.safety: Risk and safety analysis supports safeguard decisions.
industryPoints.maintenance: Maintenance strategies follow failure behavior and criticality.
industryPoints.decision: Simulation and decision support guide operations planning.
